artworks.title: El esforzado Rendon picando un toro, de cuya suerte murio en plaza de Madrid (The Forceful Rendon Stabs a Bull with the Pique, from Which Pass He Died in the Ring at Madrid)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfight scene. The artwork shows a bull charging towards a mounted rider wielding a lance, set in a traditional bullfighting arena. Other elements include a figure holding a cape and a horse nearby. In the background, spectators are watching the spectacle. The drawing conveys movement and tension using intricate lines and shading for detail and energy.

artworks.title: Pepe Illo haciendo el recorte al toro (Pepe Illo Making the Pass of the "Recorte")
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfight. The scene depicts a bull in the center, with a group of individuals interacting with it. Some are on foot and others are on horseback. The bull is poised aggressively, with its head lowered. The background shows a crowded arena, with spectators blurred in the stands. The drawing captures the intensity of the moment, highlighting the dynamic movement and drama of the bullfight.

artworks.title: Pedro Romero matando a toro parado (Pedro Romero Killing the Halted Bull)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull and a matador in a bullfighting arena. The image shows a bull facing a man with a stick or sword in a determined stance. In the background, there are spectators seated and observing. The detailed line work captures the tension of the moment between the man and the bull.

artworks.title: Banderillas de fuego (Banderillas with Firecrackers)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, lavis, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bull in a bullfighting arena. The scene captures several figures engaging with a bull within a confined space, reminiscent of an arena. The drawing shows meticulous detailing, with an emphasis on texture and line work. The figures are holding various props that could be interpreted as tools or weapons related to the act of bullfighting. The background reveals a defined wall separating the arena from the viewing stands, emphasizing the venue's layout and adding depth to the overall composition. The drawing uses a monochrome palette, which enhances the dramatic intensity of the scene through the careful play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Vision of Eliphaz
artworks.medium: engraving with border in graphite on thick paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a spectral figure appearing before a group of seated individuals. The drawing features a central cloaked figure standing tall and ethereal, confronting another creature. Below them are several individuals seated on the ground with varied expressions. The composition includes dynamic lines and shadowing to create a dramatic atmosphere. The background is filled with swirling lines. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing the contrast between the central figure's aura and the darker surroundings.

artworks.title: Job Rebuked by His Friends
artworks.medium: engraving with border and lettering in graphite onthick paper
artworks.description: The image shows several figures. The central figure is a man sitting on the ground with his legs crossed, facing forward. The man has a long beard, long hair, and a somber expression. He appears unclothed or minimally clothed. Around him are four other figures gesturing or pointing toward him. These figures are mostly shown from the waist up, in various postures. They have detailed facial features and hair. Their clothing consists of draped garments. The background features rolling hills and a building structure to the left, creating an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Canto IV, Verse 328
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. On the left, a man is leaning towards the center, holding papers and facing two women. The woman in the center has her hair up and wears a headscarf or bonnet and a long-sleeved dress, looking towards the man. On the right, another woman sits with her head resting on her hands on a small table, with a book beside her. She has long, flowing hair and wears a long gown. The setting is indoors, showing a tall, multi-paneled window with heavy curtains, and patterned wallpaper in the background. A small, round table is placed between the seated figures.

artworks.title: On Homer's Poetry (and) On Virgil
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a text with elaborate illustrations and calligraphy. The drawing features a handwritten text in a decorative and stylized manner, commenting on notable poets like Homer and Virgil. The text is divided into sections titled "On Homer's Poetry" and "On Virgil." The text is bordered and accompanied by line drawings, including a group of figures. The drawing has a distinctive style reminiscent of an engraving or block print.

artworks.title: Moses Staying the Plague (?) [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and ink with wash on two joined sheets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures around a central, robed figure with arms raised. The central figure stands with a flowing robe and commanding posture. Surrounding figures look upwards, with arms extended. The figures are muscular and idealized with a minimalistic background. Light and shadow add depth to the scene, creating a dreamy atmosphere. The drawing captures a moment of significance, suggesting themes of leadership, divinity, or collective aspiration.

artworks.title: The Belvedere Torso [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a human leg and foot in sandals. The drawing is sketched lightly with graphite on paper, capturing a portion of a statue or figure with emphasis on a lifelike depiction of the lower leg and the foot which appears to be wearing a sandal. The composition is minimalist with soft outlines defining the contours and muscles of the leg and foot, rendered with subtle shading to suggest volume and texture. The background is left bare.

artworks.title: "And Saul Said unto David, Go, and the Lord be with Thee" [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch featuring three figures in full-body view. The central figure is standing with one arm raised high and the other resting by his side. He has curly hair and a beard, with minimal facial details, wearing a draped garment. To his left stands another figure, also standing, with long hair and a large beard, more pronounced facial features, and a long robe. On the right side is another standing figure with shorter hair and draped fabric, revealing most of the legs and arms. In the background, there are lightly sketched heads and shoulders of additional figures. The composition is against a plain backdrop, focusing on the figures without environmental details.

artworks.title: Group of Men Seated in a Circle [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash over black chalk on laid paper

artworks.title: A Resurrection Scene (The Gambols of Ghosts) [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows a series of flowing lines and circular shapes creating an abstract composition. The swirls and curves suggest movement, while the circular forms resemble faces or gestures.

artworks.title: Florence Leyland
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl in a full-length portrait. She is standing, with her body slightly turned to the side and her face looking forward towards the viewer. She has long hair that flows down past her shoulders and bangs that frame her forehead. Her facial features appear soft and delicate. She is wearing a long dress that reaches down to her ankles, with detailed fabric and folds emphasized by sketch lines. The background is abstract, with vertical lines adding texture. The image has a sketched appearance, with variations in shading for depth and form. No jewelry or objects are visible in her hands.

artworks.title: St James's Street
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a busy street scene. In the distance, a building with a clock tower marks the low horizon. The etching technique features detailed lines outlining the buildings and people on the street. Buildings on both sides of the street lead towards the clock tower, creating depth. The color scheme is monochromatic with black and white shades. The street is filled with pedestrians and horse-drawn carriages, depicted with energetic strokes. Architectural details on the buildings are intricately drawn.

artworks.title: Sailing Ships in the Bassin Neuf at La Rochelle (Les Voiliers du Bassin Neuf, a La Rochelle)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with buildings and docked ships in the background, a row of ships in the distance, and small boats with sails in the foreground. The scene is depicted using fine lines, creating a detailed and light impression. The color palette is monochromatic, in various shades of brown.

artworks.title: Coast (La cote)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a horizon dividing the composition at the upper fifth. Trees, small buildings, and sailboats are visible along the horizon, against a sky background. The artwork features delicate lines, creating an etching-like impression. The color palette is monochromatic in a light sepia tone. Figures are seen wading in shallow water, engaging in leisurely activities. Wispy clouds are depicted in the sky with gentle strokes.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: This print displays a pattern of six large flowers arranged in two vertical columns. Each flower has five outlined petals with a central round shape. The flowers are distributed on both the left and right sides of the print, with one long stem connecting them in the center. The thick outlines are black, and some of the central circles are colored in a dark tan color, while the paper behind is beige and shows some small areas of discoloration. There are some small rips and tears in the paper.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration of a person from the knees up. The individual is shown slightly turned to their left, with their right hand raised and palm open towards the viewer, while their left arm is resting by their side. The face features simple, line-drawn eyes, nose, and mouth, with wavy, short hair and a cap. The person is wearing a tunic-like garment with a pattern of small squares and vertical stripes, cinched at the waist. A flower with petals is depicted near the person's left side on the ground. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: The image shows a vertical arrangement of four pairs of stylized plant-like objects, each with a stem and a pair of large, rounded, petal-like shapes oriented horizontally. The objects are primarily in shades of brown and tan, outlined and detailed with black lines. There is a central stem, with two pairs on the upper half and two pairs on the lower half.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a stylized, possibly medieval illustration style. The person is standing upright, facing slightly to the side, with their left arm extended forward. The facial features are simplistic with a slightly open mouth, and they have shoulder-length wavy or curly hair. The person wears a loose-fitting garment with vertical stripes flowing into a gathered, flared lower section resembling a tunic or robe. They hold an object resembling a large, ornate staff or candle, decorated with a pattern at the top. The background is plain, and the illustration is on a textured, aged parchment-like surface.

artworks.title: Title-Page of the Engraved Illustrations to the Book of Job
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a book cover for "The Book of Job". The cover features elaborate typography with the title "ILLUSTRATIONS of The BOOK of JOB" framed by intricately drawn, winged angelic figures surrounding the text. These figures have flowing hair and serene expressions, their wings elegantly draped around them. The lower section of the cover reads "Invented & Engraved by William Blake" with the date "1825".

artworks.title: Job and His Family
artworks.description: The illustration features a group of figures, with the entirety of their upper bodies and most of their lower bodies shown. The central figure, an older man with a long beard, stands in the middle, flanked by eight younger people on each side. The figures are posed upright, some with hands clasped in front of them. The older man has long, flowing hair, while the others have shorter, neatly styled hair. They wear simple, flowing robes. Rows of sheep surround them, with a large tree in the background holding musical instruments. Tent-like structures and a crescent moon are visible in the landscape against a hilly terrain. The sky is bright. The image is bordered by text featuring scriptural elements.
